reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output; nothing is proposed to counterparty.

Cited text supports compliance: Section 9.4(a) gives Ono the 'right (but not the obligation)' to Manufacture or engage a Subcontractor, and 9.4(b) gives Ono only a 'right to obtain from Array' its commercial requirements — no all-requirements or sole-supplier covenant binding the Customer, matching the preferred position.

Section 8.2 (Exclusivity of Efforts) is correctly noted-but-not-flagged: it is a mutual, time-limited field non-compete on Commercializing competing products rather than a sourcing/supply exclusivity, so it falls outside this rule's detection scope and its symmetry does not disadvantage us.
Deterministic check ('no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains') passes and paragraphs are unchanged, consistent with a compliant evidence-only finding.
